title: Unrestricted SSH Access (Port 22)
description: Security Group allows SSH inbound traffic from anywhere (0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0). This exposes instances to automated brute-force attacks.
fix: Restrict FromPort: 22 / ToPort: 22 CidrIp to a specific trusted IP range (e.g., 203.0.113.4/32) or utilize AWS Systems Manager Session Manager instead of public SSH.

title: Unrestricted Windows RDP Access (Port 3389)
description: Security Group allows Remote Desktop (RDP) ingress from 0.0.0.0/0, leaving Windows instances vulnerable to credential stuffing.
fix: Remove 0.0.0.0/0 on port 3389 and restrict to authorized corporate VPN CIDRs.

title: All-Traffic Open Ingress (Protocol -1)
description: Security Group rule specifies IpProtocol: -1 with open CIDR (0.0.0.0/0), opening all 65,535 TCP/UDP ports to the public internet.
fix: Replace open IpProtocol: -1 with specific protocol numbers and ports required by your application (e.g. TCP 443).

title: S3 Public Access Block Missing or Disabled
description: S3 bucket does not configure PublicAccessBlockConfiguration or has public block disabled, risking accidental data exposure.
fix: Add PublicAccessBlockConfiguration with BlockPublicAcls: true, BlockPublicPolicy: true, IgnorePublicAcls: true, and RestrictPublicBuckets: true.

title: S3 Server-Side Encryption (SSE) Not Configured
description: S3 bucket lacks explicit BucketEncryption configuration, allowing unencrypted object uploads.
fix: Add BucketEncryption properties using ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration with AES256 or aws:kms SSEAlgorithm.

title: RDS Database Publicly Accessible
description: RDS database instance has PubliclyAccessible set to true, assigning a public IP and exposing the database endpoint to the internet.
fix: Set PubliclyAccessible: false and place the database within private isolated DBSubnetGroup subnets.

title: RDS Database Storage Encryption Disabled
description: RDS instance does not have StorageEncrypted: true enabled, leaving data-at-rest unencrypted on storage volumes.
fix: Enable StorageEncrypted: true in DBInstance Properties.

title: EC2 EBS Block Device Unencrypted
description: EBS root or secondary volume attached to the EC2 instance lacks explicit encryption.
fix: Specify Encrypted: true under BlockDeviceMappings -> Ebs properties.

title: Unencrypted HTTP Allowed (Port 80)
description: Inbound HTTP port 80 is open to 0.0.0.0/0 without an enforced TLS/HTTPS redirect listener on port 443.
fix: Configure an Application Load Balancer with an HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect rule on port 443 using ACM SSL certificates.

title: IAM Policy Uses Full Administrative Wildcards
description: IAM policy specifies Action: '*' and Resource: '*', granting overly broad administrative permissions.
fix: Apply the principle of least privilege: scope down Action and Resource ARNs to only the specific services required.
